description: Canonical Product A registry for the 20 priority Indian health insurance policy concepts.

concepts.definition: Waiting period before pre-existing diseases are covered under the policy.

display_rules.not_found: Pre-existing disease waiting period not found in policy text.
display_rules.explicitly_not_covered: Pre-existing disease cover is explicitly not covered.

concepts.definition: Initial policy waiting period before non-accident claims are covered.

display_rules.not_found: Initial waiting period not found in policy text.
display_rules.explicitly_not_covered: Initial waiting period is explicitly not applicable.

concepts.definition: Waiting periods for named diseases, treatments, or procedures, excluding PED waiting.

display_rules.not_found: Specific disease waiting periods not found in policy text.
display_rules.explicitly_not_covered: Specific disease/procedure cover is explicitly not covered.

concepts.definition: Limit on hospital room rent, expressed as amount, percentage of sum insured, actuals, or schedule-dependent value.

display_rules.not_found: Room rent limit not found in policy text.
display_rules.explicitly_not_covered: Room rent limit is explicitly absent or unrestricted in the policy text.

concepts.definition: Limit on ICU charges, expressed as amount, percentage of sum insured, actuals, or schedule-dependent value.

display_rules.not_found: ICU limit not found in policy text.
display_rules.explicitly_not_covered: ICU limit is explicitly absent or unrestricted in the policy text.

concepts.definition: The percentage or component of admissible claim amount payable by the insured.

display_rules.not_found: Co-pay not found in policy text.
display_rules.explicitly_not_covered: No co-pay is explicitly stated in the policy text.

concepts.definition: Amount or percentage payable by the insured before policy benefits apply.

display_rules.not_found: Deductible not found in policy text.
display_rules.explicitly_not_covered: No deductible is explicitly stated in the policy text.

concepts.definition: Bonus or sum insured increase for claim-free years, including maximum cap where stated.

display_rules.not_found: Cumulative bonus / NCB not found in policy text.
display_rules.explicitly_not_covered: Cumulative bonus / NCB is explicitly not available.

concepts.definition: Benefit that restores sum insured after exhaustion, including conditions where stated.

display_rules.not_found: Restoration benefit not found in policy text.
display_rules.explicitly_not_covered: Restoration benefit is explicitly not available.

concepts.definition: Coverage for Ayurveda, Yoga and Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, and Homeopathy treatment.

display_rules.not_found: AYUSH coverage not found in policy text.
display_rules.explicitly_not_covered: AYUSH treatment is explicitly not covered.

concepts.definition: Coverage for listed modern treatments and advanced procedures, including sub-limits where stated.

display_rules.not_found: Modern treatment coverage not found in policy text.
display_rules.explicitly_not_covered: Modern treatment coverage is explicitly not available.

concepts.definition: Waiting period before maternity expenses are covered, where maternity cover exists.

display_rules.not_found: Maternity waiting period not found in policy text.
display_rules.explicitly_not_covered: Maternity expenses are explicitly not covered.

concepts.definition: Coverage for newborn baby expenses or newborn treatment.

display_rules.not_found: Newborn coverage not found in policy text.
display_rules.explicitly_not_covered: Newborn coverage is explicitly not available.

concepts.definition: Coverage for medical expenses related to organ donor treatment or harvesting.

display_rules.not_found: Organ donor coverage not found in policy text.
display_rules.explicitly_not_covered: Organ donor expenses are explicitly not covered.

concepts.definition: Coverage for road ambulance, emergency ambulance, or transport expenses.

display_rules.not_found: Ambulance coverage not found in policy text.
display_rules.explicitly_not_covered: Ambulance expenses are explicitly not covered.

concepts.definition: Period after receiving the policy during which the policyholder can review and cancel under free-look rules.

display_rules.not_found: Free look period not found in policy text.
display_rules.explicitly_not_covered: Free look period is explicitly not applicable.

concepts.definition: Period after premium due date during which renewal/payment may be made while preserving continuity rules.

display_rules.not_found: Grace period not found in policy text.
display_rules.explicitly_not_covered: Grace period is explicitly not applicable.

concepts.definition: Whether and how the policy can be renewed, including lifelong renewability where stated.

display_rules.not_found: Renewability terms not found in policy text.
display_rules.explicitly_not_covered: Policy renewal is explicitly not available.

concepts.definition: Timeline for notifying the insurer or TPA about a claim, hospitalization, injury, or covered event.

display_rules.not_found: Claim intimation timeline not found in policy text.
display_rules.explicitly_not_covered: Claim intimation timeline is explicitly not applicable.

concepts.definition: Timeline for settlement, rejection, or repudiation of a claim after receipt of required documents.

display_rules.not_found: Claim settlement timeline not found in policy text.
display_rules.explicitly_not_covered: Claim settlement timeline is explicitly not applicable.
